text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syria-China talks open in Peking. Cooperation in all fields stressed. China's support for Syria appreciated.
- Islamic foreign ministers meet in Jakarta: Syrian Foreign Minister Shara says Israeli government cancelled peace option.
- Egyptian President Mubarak: freeze of peace process due to Israeli obstacles.
- GCC summit calls for Israel's full withdrawal from the occupied Arab lands.
- Head of Syria's computer society Bashar al-Assad, son of Syrian president, opens symposium on Arabic language in computer software.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu continues his deluding statements.
- Israeli aggressions continue against south Lebanon. Resistance attacks occupation targets.
- Israel affirms intention to continue expansion of settlements.
- Lebanon's ceasefire monitoring committe meets in Naqoura.
- Israeli-Turkish economic talks to open in Turkey.
